newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down on economic uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down on economic uncertainty.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Monday on fears of a further weakening of the rupee against the dollar and bleak economic prospects, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 6.66 points, or 0.49 percent, to end at 1,356.12. Losers led gainers 159 to 79.

"People expect the rupee to slid further despite its recent 3.65 percent devaluation," a dealer said. "Investors lack confidence in Pakistan's economy and there is no investment coming in the stock market as the dollar offers better returns."
PTCL fell 0.50 to 33.65 rupees and Packages Ltd 15 to 65.
